## [1.1.0](https://github.com/myvoow/LiquidMusic/compare/v1.0.2...v1.1.0) (2026-11-02)

### ✨ New Features

* Make the glass clear, without blur ([cff9676](https://github.com/myvoow/LiquidMusic/commit/cff9676e2ec3b56ec196b07dcb6d172646e76bef))

patches.name: Liquid Glass
patches.description: Replaces the blur behind the floating tab bar and the mini player with clear Liquid Glass: refracted edges, vibrancy and a specular rim, without blur. Refraction requires Android 13, vibrancy Android 12.

options.description: Blur of the content behind the glass, in dp. Off keeps the glass clear, as Liquid Glass.
Width of the bent band along the edges of the glass, in dp. 0 disables the refraction.
How far the content is displaced at the very edge of the glass, in dp.
Saturation of the content behind the glass, in percent. 100 keeps the colors unchanged.
Opacity kept from the translucent material Apple Music draws over the tab bar and the mini player, in percent. Lower values show more of the glass.
Intensity of the light reflected on the rim of the glass, in percent.
Splits the colors of the refracted edges, like a prism (Android 13+).
Also applies the glass to the floating search bar and to the top bar on tablets.
